question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ABOLISH
solution:
The correct answer is '**Continue**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Abolish**' is '**Continue**'.
 
• **Abolish**: to end a law or system officially. (किसी क़ानून या प्रथा को आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्‍त करना)
 
 
• *Example: When was capital punishment **abolished** here?*
 
 
 
• **Continue**: to keep happening or existing without stopping. (होते रहना; जारी रहना; लगातार बने रहना)
 
 
• *Example: If the pain **continues**, see your doctor.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Continue.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Disprove**: to show that something is not true. किसी बात को असत्‍य सिद्घ करना
 
• **Contest**: a competition to find out who is the best, strongest, most beautiful, etc. (सर्वश्रेष्ठ सर्वशक्तिशाली तथा सबसे सुंदर ढूढ़ँने की प्रतियोगिता; प्रतिस्‍पर्धा, मुक़ाबला, प्रतियोगिता)
 
• **Disclose**: to tell something to somebody or to make something known publicly. (किसी को कोई बात बताना या सार्वजनिक रूप से प्रकट करना)
